seo.desc: Fotorealistické 3D rendery a animace produktů z výkresů, CAD dat nebo fotek. Varianty barev a materiálů pro e-shop, tisk i reklamu. Pošlete nezávaznou poptávku.

intro: Postavíme 3D model produktu podle výkresů, CAD dat nebo fotek a rozměrů a vyrenderujeme ho ve fotorealistické kvalitě. Rendery použijete v e-shopu, katalogu, na billboardu i v reklamním spotu.

Výhoda 3D je v opakovatelnosti: z jednoho modelu připravíte libovolné barevné varianty, nové úhly nebo animaci, aniž byste znovu fotili. Pracujeme v Blenderu a výstupy ladíme tak, aby šly vedle skutečných fotek.

en.lead: Show a product before it exists, or from an angle no camera can reach.

seo.title: 3D modelling and product renders in Blender
seo.desc: Photorealistic 3D product renders and animation from drawings, CAD data or photos. Colour and material variants for e-shops, print and ads. Send a free enquiry.

intro: We build a 3D model of your product from drawings, CAD data or photos and dimensions, and render it photorealistically. Use the renders in your e-shop, catalogue, on billboards or in a TV spot.
The beauty of 3D is repeatability: one model gives you any colour variant, new angle or animation without another shoot. We work in Blender and tune the output to sit next to real photos.
inc: 3D model from drawings, CAD data or photos
Materials and textures matched to samples

equip.x: Blender (Cycles and EEVEE) for modelling, materials and rendering
Import of CAD and 3D formats (STEP, OBJ, FBX, GLB)

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: Ideally drawings or CAD data. Photos and dimensions also work.

faq.q: How much does a 3D product render cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope, timing and complexity. After a short call we send you a tailored quote, free and non-binding.

faq.q: Can renders be used in ads?
faq.a: Yes, we deliver renders and animation at web, print and video quality.

faq.q: Can the model be changed later?
faq.a: Yes. The model stays, so new variants are quicker.

faq.q: Can you make a model for the web and AR?
faq.a: Yes, we export GLB and USDZ for 3D viewers on websites.
